Pulse 0.1.4 is a major mobile experience update focused on polish, privacy, and reliability.

## What's new

- Redesigned the mobile interface with clearer cards, spacing, borders, and responsive navigation.
- Added horizontal swipe navigation between Today, Programme, and Settings.
- Improved exercise expansion and reordering with smoother animations, larger drag targets, and clearer feedback.
- Added an exercise picker directly to the Programme editor.
- Added optional automatic backups from immediately after a change up to 24 hours later, using an Android folder chosen by the user.
- Added an option to preserve the previous configuration before overwriting it.
- Added launcher icons that follow the selected Catppuccin flavour and accent colour.
- Reworked the Pulse icon and splash artwork for sharper Android rendering.

## Privacy and behaviour

- Today completion state now stays in date-scoped local app storage and resets when the day changes.
- Completion state is excluded from exports and automatic backups.
- Android backups use scoped folder access; Pulse does not request broad storage access.
- Android system cloud backup remains disabled.

## Fixes

- Removed the unwanted native Android title bar above the app interface.
- Fixed flicking when dismissing the exercise drawer.
- Improved drag-and-drop behaviour when reversing direction or releasing between positions.
- Prevented accidental text selection on controls while keeping exercise text selectable.
- Improved offline storage and service-worker update handling.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/nyxar77/Pulse/compare/0.1.3...0.1.4
